race.comment: WESTERN MISS (7) showed she was an above-average commodity last campaign, winning two back impressively before coming back to 1400m and missing as an odds-on pop. Freshened since that effort and has trialled nicely coming in. Has the speed to offset the tricky draw and she can fire back in grade. I'M CRAFTY (2) missed the start last week and never got into the race. Good winner two back and that level stacks up in this field. CJP sticks with him and with a cleaner getaway this time around, he can put his best foot forward. TAHNI TALK (1) was strong from the back in the Derby before the break and was a winner over 1400m first-up in his last campaign. He's a classy customer and while this is short of his best, he has upside and can be storming home late in the race. RUTHLESS ANGEL (13) looks as though she wants this trip now and she can raise the bar. DESERT WAVES (4) is better than he showed fresh and can improve.
